integrity: The proof is a direct algebraic consequence of the published local exchange relations and the boundary-one length-2 symmetry. No finite search, numerical experiment, or unproved computational certificate is used for the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Boundary entries are required to be 1 and only heights 1 and 2 are proved rigid. The result does not classify all commuting pentagon friezes or arbitrary-coefficient friezes. Height 3 is claimed only as the first possible height for genuinely noncommuting entries, with existence witnessed by the published quaternionic example.
title: Boundary-one pentagon friezes over division rings are forced commutative
